title: ...set up a brand new iPhone
desc: Migrate data smoothly while locking down essential privacy controls.
todos: Use Quick Start proximity migration while keeping both phones plugged in.
Set up Face ID and configure Stolen Device Protection in settings.
Enable iCloud Backup and verify Messages and Photos are syncing.
Review App Tracking Transparency and set all app permission prompts to Ask.
Enable Find My iPhone including network offline location tracking.
